subsystem: input token classification and expression evaluation
implementation: handwritten high-level C parser and integer-decimal arithmetic; original packed constant tables read as data

implemented_routines.name: decode evaluator token
implemented_routines.scope: returned value and category for every input byte and calculation context

implemented_routines.name: classify display token
implemented_routines.scope: returned category for every input byte

implemented_routines.name: classify display construct
implemented_routines.scope: returned category for every input byte

implemented_routines.name: evaluate expression
implemented_routines.scope: COMP tokens: literals, scientific input, e/pi, parentheses, unary signs, arithmetic, stronger implicit multiplication, compact/mixed fractions with native operand eligibility, square root and forward and inverse sin/cos/tan, ln/log10 Math on/off; verified fast powers−1/0/2/3, square/cube/reciprocal and angle-unit postfix; status, numeric records and consumed pointer; nested expression-to-LCD checks

implemented_routines.name: post-operation numeric cleanup
implemented_routines.scope: decimal path after successful COMP arithmetic dispatch

implemented_routines.name: forward trigonometric dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: degree/radian/grad settings, numeric cores, special-result replacement and operation cleanup

implemented_routines.name: verified power dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: integer exponents−1/0/2/3 only; right association, power above fraction and implicit multiplication, unary sign below power

implemented_routines.name: explicit angle-unit postfix
implemented_routines.scope: degree/radian/grad source unit to current configured unit, error cursor position

implemented_routines.name: inverse trigonometric and logarithmic function dispatch
implemented_routines.scope: rawB0/B1/B2 asin/acos/atan in all angle units; raw68 single-argument log10 and A3 ln; domain errors and nested expression-to-LCD checks

gaps: general powers, other root types, remaining postfix operators, hyperbolic/exponential functions, arbitrary-base logarithms and full function dispatch
number literal parsing in all bases
full error/recovery behavior in other contexts, expression editing and keyboard integration
unsupported_behavior: explicit FX_EVAL_UNIMPLEMENTED and offending token; no host libm or CPU/ROM fallback
